fact: IB Gateway is a stripped-down, headless-friendly version of TWS: same login, same API, no charts; uses roughly 40% fewer resources; recommended for algo boxes
pysystemtrade recommends the Gateway over TWS ('much more stable and lightweight')
TWS API has no access fee; only market data subscriptions are paid
Commission schedule is per product/exchange, not per channel; no source found that charges API orders differently from TWS orders
note: absence of a channel surcharge, not an explicit IBKR statement

fact: API access requires IBKR Pro; IBKR Lite accounts get 'API support is not available for accounts that support commission free trading'
IBKR Lite is offered to US residents; EEA residents are served by Interactive Brokers Ireland on IBKR Pro

fact: No monthly activity/inactivity fee since 1 July 2021 (Lite and Pro)
Additional usernames are free; only one brokerage session per username, so a dedicated API username avoids the Gateway being kicked out when you log in on mobile/TWS
Market data is billed per username and cannot be shared between usernames: subscribe on the API username only
Real-time data subscriptions need USD 500 equity plus the subscription cost (individual account)
Paper-trading account is free and works with the same API (Gateway port 4002 paper vs 4001 live; TWS 7497/7496)
Live real-time subscriptions can be shared with the paper account (Account Settings > Paper Trading); otherwise paper gets delayed data (US futures 10 min)
IB Gateway: about 4 GB RAM (8 GB recommended) on Windows 10+/Ubuntu 18.04+; bundles its own Java; one instance under load can use about 1 GB
TWS/Gateway (v974+) restart automatically each day without re-authentication (Auto Restart, Mon-Sat); choose Auto Restart, not Auto Log Off
Weekly: after the Saturday-night reset, a full login with second factor is required the first time the Gateway runs after 01:00 ET on Sunday
2FA is mandatory for live accounts and cannot be disabled for trading platforms; IBKR Mobile (IB Key) push is the practical method
IBC cannot approve the 2FA itself; it re-sends the alert if missed (ReloginAfterSecondFactorAuthenticationTimeout=yes), alert times out after about 3 minutes
IBC RESTART command cannot bypass the Sunday full second-factor authentication
